items.summary: Create an Order data type in the backend that stores customer phone number, delivery address, order items (product IDs and quantities), total price, order timestamp, and caller Principal
Implement a backend function to create and store orders that accepts phone number, address, and cart items, calculates total price, and persists the order with caller Principal and current timestamp
Add a backend query function to retrieve all orders for the admin dashboard that returns array of orders with customer details, items, and totals
Create a checkout page component at /checkout route that displays cart summary, input fields for phone number and delivery address, order total in Indian Rupees, and a 'Place Order' button

Implement checkout flow that calls the backend order creation function with phone number and address, clears the cart on success, and displays confirmation message 'Your order will be delivered today!'
Add 'Proceed to Checkout' button to the cart page that navigates to /checkout route when cart has items

Add an Orders section to the admin dashboard that displays all customer orders in a table with columns for order date/time, customer phone number, delivery address, items ordered, and total price in Indian Rupees
Create a React Query hook for placing orders that calls the backend order creation function and invalidates cart queries on success
Create a React Query hook for fetching all orders in the admin dashboard that calls the backend orders query function
